team.en: So around the age of 20, he decided to try out for an NFL team.
team.zh: 所以在20岁左右的时候，他决定去试训NFL球队。

team.en: When the experiment was over, Zimbardo and his team reflected on what they had seen.
team.zh: 实验结束后，Zimbardo 和他的团队对所目睹的一切进行了反思。

team.en: Henning and his team studied what happened when people watched videos of itching and scratching.
team.zh: Henning 和他的团队研究了人们在观看挠痒视频时会有怎样的反应。

team.en: There are also team routines where one swimmer is lifted up out of the water.
team.zh: 还有集体项目的成套动作，其中一名游泳运动员会被托举出水面。

team.en: That’s an independent league, meaning there’s no direct path to a big-league team.
team.zh: 那是一个独立联盟，意味着没有通往大联盟球队的直接道路。

test.en: You failed a test. You were bullied. And I don't say this like dismissively.
test.zh: 你考试不及格。你被霸凌了。我这么说并不是为了轻描淡写。

test.en: You can put your full focus and dedicate yourself to one target: passing that test.
test.zh: 你可以集中全部精力，致力于一个目标：通过那个考试。

test.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
test.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

test.en: Just like passing the driving test gave me a clear and urgent reason to learn.
test.zh: 就像通过驾考给了我一个清晰而紧迫的学习理由一样。

test.en: Well, it's actually been put to the test a lot more recently than 10,000 years ago.
test.zh: 其实，就在比一万年前近得多的时候，这个理论已经接受过实打实的检验。

tend.en: Study abroad students who have greater interaction with local people tend to benefit more.
tend.zh: 与当地人有更多互动的留学生往往受益更多。

tend.en: They also tend to learn more. Asking good questions demonstrates curiosity, confidence, and respect.
tend.zh: 他们往往也学得更多。提出好问题体现了好奇心、自信和尊重。

tend.en: For example, algorithms tend to show us what we already like and agree with.
tend.zh: 例如，算法倾向于向我们展示我们已经喜欢并认同的内容。

tend.en: The oldest surviving codices (which is the plural of codex) tend to be religious texts.
tend.zh: 现存最古老的手抄本（codices是codex的复数）往往是宗教文本。

tend.en: If something tends to happen, it happens often and is likely to happen again.
tend.zh: 如果某事倾向于发生，它就会经常发生，并且很可能会再次发生。

teaching.en: We’re interested in that synchronous, which means at the same time, online language teaching.
teaching.zh: 我们感兴趣的是同步的——也就是在同一时间的——在线语言教学。

teaching.en: The exam system, the way that English is measured, changes the style of teaching.
teaching.zh: 考试系统，即衡量英语水平的方式，改变了教学风格。

teaching.en: Let me start this episode by teaching you a completely pointless piece of English vocabulary.
teaching.zh: 先让我用一个完全无用的英语词汇来开启这期节目。

teaching.en: Schools and universities all have a role to play in teaching these skills.
teaching.zh: 学校和大学在教授这些技能方面都扮演着重要角色。

teaching.en: Mustafa Kemal himself went from town to town, teaching people how to use the new script.
teaching.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔亲自走访城镇，教人们如何使用新文字。

terrible.en: But she was exaggerating. Her day wasn't really terrible – more like strange or annoying.
terrible.zh: 但她是在夸张。她的一天并不是真的那么糟糕——更像是有点奇怪或烦人。

terrible.en: Perhaps you think something like, “I have a terrible memory, so I’ll never learn vocabulary.”
terrible.zh: 也许你会想：“我记性太差了，所以永远也学不会词汇。”

terrible.en: Wherever you go, there’s going to be great English schools and also terrible English schools.
terrible.zh: 无论你去哪里，都会有很棒的英语学校，也会有糟糕的英语学校。

terrible.en: Even where you live, your country, your food culture, is going to have terrible dishes.
terrible.zh: 即使在你居住的地方，你国家的饮食文化中也会有一些糟糕的菜肴。

terrible.en: Now, the fact that the price has increased so drastically isn’t a terrible thing in itself.
terrible.zh: 现在，房价大幅上涨这一事实本身并不是一件可怕的事情。

term.en: Donald Trump, under the American Constitution, cannot serve more than two terms as President.
term.zh: 根据美国宪法，唐纳德·特朗普担任总统不能超过两届。

term.en: Wealth in the terms of buying numerous properties or having a massive pension fund.
term.zh: 这里所说的财富是指购买多处房产或拥有庞大的养老金基金。

term.en: They donate money to politicians. They are on friendly terms with influential government figures.
term.zh: 他们向政治家捐款。他们与有影响力的政府人物保持着友好的关系。

term.en: These are borrowed English terms, but they’re not the terms actually used in English.
term.zh: 这些是借用的英语术语，但它们并不是英语中真正使用的词汇。

term.en: These are borrowed English terms, but they’re not the terms actually used in English.
term.zh: 这些是借用的英语术语，但它们并不是英语中真正使用的词汇。

temperature.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
temperature.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

temperature.en: OK, Phil. So, I asked by how much has the world's average temperature increased since 1970.
temperature.zh: 好的，Phil。我刚才问的是，自1970年以来，世界平均气温上升了多少。

temperature.en: I asked how much world leaders agreed to limit global temperature rises to.
temperature.zh: 我问的是世界领导人同意将全球气温上升限制在多少以内。

temperature.en: The lowest temperature ever recorded on Earth was at the Vostok Research Station in Antarctica in 1983.
temperature.zh: 地球上有记录以来的最低气温是1983年在南极洲的东方站（Vostok Research Station）录得的。

temperature.en: Caroline guesses that scientists will focus on the planet’s temperature and whether it could support life.
temperature.zh: Caroline 猜测科学家将专注于该行星的温度以及它是否能支持生命。

technology.en: While technology can spread information, it can also help fight it when used responsibly.
technology.zh: 虽然技术可以传播信息，但如果使用得当，它也可以帮助打击虚假信息。

technology.en: He moved to California and started working in venture capital, investing in technology startups.
technology.zh: 他搬到加利福尼亚，开始从事风险投资，投资科技初创公司。

technology.en: But it is at least philosophy that is informed by technology and by science.
technology.zh: 但它至少是受技术和科学启发的哲学。

technology.en: Vancouver is a place of technology and film production and international trade with Asia.
technology.zh: 温哥华则是科技、影视制作以及与亚洲开展国际贸易的重镇。

technology.en: Human behavior and emotions and decision making don’t change as quickly as technology does.
technology.zh: 人类的行为、情绪和决策并不像技术那样变化得那么快。

terrify.en: A huge maze built under the city. Inside the maze lived a terrifying monster.
terrify.zh: 一个建在城市下面的巨大迷宫。迷宫里住着一个可怕的怪物。

terrify.en: For the children to confront their terrifying experiences, they must start with more simple things, like learning to sleep alone.
terrify.zh: 为了让孩子们直面他们可怕的经历，他们必须从更简单的事情开始，比如学习独自睡觉。
数量虽然不多，但极具威慑力。

terrify.en: And the idea of just living an okay life just sounds so terrifying to me that the freedom to fail over and over again is still more fulfilling to me.
terrify.zh: 而那种仅仅过着“还行”的生活的想法对我来说太可怕了，以至于一次又一次经历失败的自由对我来说仍然更有成就感。

terrify.en: It's just, you know, I understand the stigma because there's a terrifying notion that comes with saying that you're broken But I don't think it's about saying that we're broken It's just about like understanding our cracks Did you understand your cracks from it?
terrify.zh: 只是，你知道，我理解那种污名，因为说自己‘破碎’带有一种可怕的观念。但我认为这并不是说我们破碎了，只是为了理解我们身上的裂痕。你通过它理解了自己的裂痕吗？

technical.en: And, I'm not saying we should. I mean, it's become a very technical discipline.
technical.zh: 我不是说我们应该有更多哲学家。我是说，经济学已经变成了一门非常技术化的学科。

technical.en: It acquits someone who is, by any technical reading of the law, guilty.
technical.zh: 他们会判某个从法律技术层面来看明明有罪的人无罪。

technical.en: You don’t need any technical skills. You just need to know how to communicate with AI.
technical.zh: 你不需要任何技术技能。你只需要知道如何与AI沟通。

technical.en: Science uses lots of jargon – specialist or technical vocabulary which is quite different from everyday language.
technical.zh: 科学使用了大量的行话——专业或技术词汇，这与日常语言有很大不同。

technical.en: My instructors spoke quickly. They used technical language and they expected me to immediately understand.
technical.zh: 我的教练语速很快。他们使用专业术语，并期望我能立即听懂。

temporary.en: These temporary barriers were soon replaced by a complex and heavily fortified wall system.
temporary.zh: 这些临时屏障很快就被一个复杂且戒备森严的墙体系统所取代。

temporary.en: This type of poverty is often temporary, but without support it can become long term.
temporary.zh: 这种类型的贫困通常是暂时的，但如果没有支持，它可能会变成长期的。

temporary.en: Is the UK becoming a temporary study destination rather than a long-term opportunity?
temporary.zh: 英国正在变成一个临时的学习目的地，而不是一个长期的发展机会吗？

temporary.en: For Fawcett this was a temporary setback, and he soon started planning another mission.
temporary.zh: 对 Fawcett 来说，这只是暂时的挫折，他很快就开始筹划另一次任务。

temporary.en: These are divided into two groups: permanent members and temporary members.
temporary.zh: 它们分为两组：常任理事国和非常任理事国。

technique.en: Two useful techniques that combine several question types are funnel questions and iterative questions.
technique.zh: 有两个结合了多种提问类型的实用技巧，分别是漏斗式提问和迭代式提问。

technique.en: As it turned out, the new technique produced tangible results, results which are real and measurable.
technique.zh: 事实证明，这项新技术产生了切实的成果，即真实且可量化的成果。

technique.en: We'll find out how useful some of these techniques are in today's programme.
technique.zh: 在今天的节目中我们将探讨其中一些技巧有多大用处。

technique.en: It uses the language and the techniques of Indian cuisine, but was adapted for British flavors.
technique.zh: 它使用了印度料理的语言和技术，但为了适应英国人的口味进行了改良。

technique.en: Cooking became more refined in France. Chefs began developing new techniques.
technique.zh: 法国的烹饪变得更加精细。厨师们开始开发新的技术。

tense.en: For a few tense hours that afternoon, it looked as though the coup might actually succeed.
tense.zh: 那天下午在几个紧张的小时里，政变似乎真的有可能成功。

tense.en: When someone's at ease, they feel comfortable and unstressed, whereas a tense person is worried and unable to relax.
tense.zh: 当某人“at ease”时，他们感到舒适且没有压力，而一个“tense”的人则感到焦虑且无法放松。

tense.en: And the next speaker thinks saunas are great if you feel tense – an adjective meaning worried and unable to relax.
tense.zh: 下一位发言者认为，如果你感到“tense”（紧张）——一个表示焦虑且无法放松的形容词，那么桑拿会很棒。

tense.en: Focus on the right word order, the correct tense, the correct question form, and of course all of that matters.
tense.zh: 专注于正确的词序、正确的时态、正确的疑问句形式，当然这些都很重要。

tense.en: Maybe you weren’t sure you’d used the right tense, or whether this was how a native speaker would have written it.
tense.zh: 也许你不确定自己是否用了正确的时态，或者母语者是否会这样写。

temptation.en: Having the words ready will reduce your temptation to switch to your first language.
temptation.zh: 把单词准备好会减少你切换到第一语言的冲动。

temptation.en: It also means resisting the temptation to plan your next question while the other person is still talking.
temptation.zh: 这也意味着克制住那种在别人还在说话时就急着盘算下一个问题的冲动。

temptation.en: The Bible says plenty about temptation, none of which I can specifically remember, the upshot of which is that temptation is everywhere.
temptation.zh: 圣经里有很多关于诱惑的论述，具体内容我记不太清了，但核心结论就是诱惑无处不在。

temptation.en: The Bible says plenty about temptation, none of which I can specifically remember, the upshot of which is that temptation is everywhere.
temptation.zh: 圣经里有很多关于诱惑的论述，具体内容我记不太清了，但核心结论就是诱惑无处不在。

temptation.en: Because, the temptations of rent-seeking to hamper innovators is so depressing and so important for understanding why certain countries stay poor.
temptation.zh: 因为，寻租行为对创新者的阻挠诱惑实在令人沮丧，而这对于理解为什么某些国家始终贫穷又至关重要。

terror.en: If you think about what you have to do as a spy, you have to be reading people really quickly, spotting complex patterns and solving problems really quickly, so you can see whether there's a terror threat.
terror.zh: 如果你想想作为一名间谍必须做些什么，你必须能够非常迅速地看透人心、发现复杂的模式并极其快速地解决问题，这样你才能看出是否存在恐怖威胁。

telegraph.en: I forget which one it's called. Maybe it's the Telegraph, I'm not sure.
telegraph.zh: 我忘了叫什么名字。可能是《每日电讯报》，我不确定。

telegraph.en: And then I'm reading, you know, The Telegraph and The Economist.
telegraph.zh: 然后我读《每日电讯报》和《经济学人》。

telegraph.en: It had newspapers. An opera house. A telegraph office.
telegraph.zh: 镇上有报纸，有歌剧院，还有电报局。

telegraph.en: For a while, all went well. Fawcett sent intermittent updates via runners who carried letters back to the edges of the jungle, where telegraphs could relay his words to the wider world.
telegraph.zh: 有一段时间，一切都很顺利。Fawcett 通过信使断断续续地发回消息，信使将信件带到丛林边缘，再由电报将他的话语传送到更广阔的世界。

telegraph.en: You mentioned MySpace as one of the earliest social media platforms, but the first electronic message was actually sent much earlier, in 1844, using a series of dots and dashes tapped out by hand on a telegraph wire.
telegraph.zh: 你提到 MySpace 是最早的社交媒体平台之一，但第一条电子信息实际上发送得要早得多，是在 1844 年，通过在电报线上手工敲出一系列点和划来发送的。

tear.en: His trousers were torn to shreds, his arm was damaged, and his eardrum burst.
tear.zh: 他的裤子被炸成了碎片，手臂受伤，耳膜破裂。

tear.en: Odysseus, the great Greek warrior, is forced to wipe the tears from his eyes.
tear.zh: 奥德修斯这位伟大的希腊勇士，强忍着擦去了眼角的泪水。

tear.en: They welcomed Europeans fleeing war torn countries, and later migrants from Asia and the Pacific.
tear.zh: 他们欢迎逃离战火国家的欧洲人，后来又迎来了来自亚洲和太平洋地区的移民。

tear.en: Wear and tear refers to the damage that comes from using something every day.
tear.zh: “Wear and tear”指日常使用所带来的损伤。

tear.en: They tore off their numbers, refused to leave their cells, and shouted at the guards.
tear.zh: 他们撕掉编号，拒绝走出牢房，还对狱警大喊大叫。

teenager.en: For most people, it would have been impossible to learn from, especially for a teenager.
teenager.zh: 对大多数人来说，要从中学习是不可能的，对一个青少年来说尤其如此。

teenager.en: They are teenagers, trained by Tanzanian military advisers and armed with AK-47 rifles.
teenager.zh: 他们都是十几岁的青少年，由坦桑尼亚军事顾问训练，配备着 AK-47 步枪。

teenager.en: At times, most teenagers are self-conscious about their looks, and having acne adds to social pressure.
teenager.zh: 有时候，大多数青少年对自己的外表感到自我意识过强，而长青春痘则增加了社交压力。

teenager.en: I remember I was reading out of that book when I was a teenager, and I loved it.
teenager.zh: 我记得我十几岁的时候读过那本书，我很喜欢。

teenager.en: And he probably saw on some level that I was some angsty teenager that felt angry about whatever.
teenager.zh: 他可能在某种程度上看出我是一个对任何事情都感到愤怒的焦虑青少年。

texture.en: As well as the satisfying sound of a loud crunch, the texture of crunchy food is important too.
texture.zh: 除了响亮嘎吱声带来的满足感外，酥脆食物的口感也很重要。

texture.en: Yeah, I've always been a meat eater, but I do need a plant-based product to be similar in terms of flavour, texture, and appearance.
texture.zh: 是的，我一直是个肉食者，但我确实需要一个在风味、质地和外观上都相似的植物产品。

texture.en: These include things like the taste, colour and texture of the sausage – in other words, whether a plant-based sausage looks and feels like real meat.
texture.zh: 这些因素包括香肠的味道、颜色和质地——换句话说，植物香肠看起来和摸起来是否像真正的肉。

texture.en: But then I think it's everyone we come into contact with, that gives us the icing that gives us the shape that gives us the dynamic texture that makes us who we are.
texture.zh: 但我认为正是我们接触到的每一个人，给了我们糖霜，给了我们形状，给了我们那份塑造我们个性的质感。

texture.en: You know, and so I, strangely enough, I feel like it's all of these people that I was lucky enough, or unlucky enough to bump into that gave me a little bit of that texture and shape.
texture.zh: 所以，奇怪的是，我觉得正是所有这些我有幸或不幸遇到的人，给了我那一点点质感和形状。

tedious.en: These weren’t glamorous roles. They were administrative, bureaucratic, and sometimes tedious.
tedious.zh: 这些并不是光鲜亮丽的角色。它们是行政性的、官僚作风的，有时甚至是枯燥乏味的。

tedious.en: And when you weren't eating your meagre rations of food, you were working, long hours doing hard, tedious work.
tedious.zh: 当你不用吃那些微薄的口粮时，你就在工作，长时间地从事又重又枯燥的工作。

tedious.en: Obviously, we have our requirements around work and obligations that are genuinely important to us, but don't fritter away your life on randomly scheduled things. and things that aren't important don't matter and events and weddings and you know tedious dinners with tedious people that you don't want to go to to the extent you can bring freedom into your life optimized for that you'll actually be more productive you won't just be happier more free you will be more productive because then you can focus on what is in front of you whatever the biggest problem of that day when i wake up in the morning the first four hours are when i have the most energy and that's when i want to solve all the hard problems and the next four hours are when I kind of want to do some more outdoorsy activities or I want to work out or maybe I can have some meetings, but I'll try to do those last second based on whatever the day's priorities demand.
tedious.zh: 显然，我们在工作和义务方面有对我们真正重要的要求，但不要把你的生命浪费在随机安排的事情上。那些不重要的事情根本不重要，比如活动、婚礼，还有那些你不想参加的、与无聊的人进行的无聊晚餐。在你能将自由带入生活的范围内，优化它，你实际上会更有效率。你不仅会更快乐、更自由，你还会更有效率，因为那时你可以专注于眼前的事情。无论我早上醒来时当天最大的问题是什么，前四个小时是我精力最充沛的时候，那是我想要解决所有难题的时候。接下来的四个小时，我可能想做一些户外活动，或者我想锻炼，或者也许我可以开一些会议，但我会尽量根据当天优先事项的需求在最后一刻决定。

tedious.en: Obviously, we have our requirements around work and obligations that are genuinely important to us, but don't fritter away your life on randomly scheduled things. and things that aren't important don't matter and events and weddings and you know tedious dinners with tedious people that you don't want to go to to the extent you can bring freedom into your life optimized for that you'll actually be more productive you won't just be happier more free you will be more productive because then you can focus on what is in front of you whatever the biggest problem of that day when i wake up in the morning the first four hours are when i have the most energy and that's when i want to solve all the hard problems and the next four hours are when I kind of want to do some more outdoorsy activities or I want to work out or maybe I can have some meetings, but I'll try to do those last second based on whatever the day's priorities demand.
tedious.zh: 显然，我们在工作和义务方面有对我们真正重要的要求，但不要把你的生命浪费在随机安排的事情上。那些不重要的事情根本不重要，比如活动、婚礼，还有那些你不想参加的、与无聊的人进行的无聊晚餐。在你能将自由带入生活的范围内，优化它，你实际上会更有效率。你不仅会更快乐、更自由，你还会更有效率，因为那时你可以专注于眼前的事情。无论我早上醒来时当天最大的问题是什么，前四个小时是我精力最充沛的时候，那是我想要解决所有难题的时候。接下来的四个小时，我可能想做一些户外活动，或者我想锻炼，或者也许我可以开一些会议，但我会尽量根据当天优先事项的需求在最后一刻决定。

testify.en: One witness testified that the inmates had been so hungry that when a horse died in the yard, they had been grateful, because it meant more bones to grind, and more scraps to fight over.
testify.zh: 一位证人作证说，院民们饿得实在没办法，当院子里有一匹马死掉时，他们竟然心存感激，因为这意味着有更多的骨头可以磨，有更多的残渣可以争抢。

testify.en: A woman testified that she had been too frightened to report anything, because to report the master was to risk punishment, and in the workhouse, the master controlled everything: your food, your sleeping arrangements, and your ability to see your children.
testify.zh: 一位妇女作证说，她太害怕而不敢举报任何事情，因为举报主管就意味着面临惩罚，而在济贫院里，主管控制着一切：你的食物、你的睡眠安排以及你看望孩子的权力。

territory.en: It was a gigantic territory, greater even than the Roman Empire at its height.
territory.zh: 这是一个巨大的领土，甚至比全盛时期的罗马帝国还要大。

territory.en: He fled Arizona Territory, rode north into Colorado and never returned to Arizona.
territory.zh: 他逃离了亚利桑那领地，一路北上进入科罗拉多，从此再也没有回过亚利桑那。

territory.en: Why? Why is France stretched across territories thousands of kilometers away from Paris?
territory.zh: 为什么？为什么法国的领土会延伸到距离巴黎数千公里之外的地方？

territory.en: However, the neighboring country of Comoros continues to claim Mayotte as its territory.
territory.zh: 然而，邻国科摩罗继续宣称马约特是其领土。

territory.en: Brandenburg-Prussia was a union of two territories ruled by the same royal family.
territory.zh: 勃兰登堡-普鲁士是由同一个皇室统治的两个领土的联盟。

tenant.en: The key seems to be balancing tenant protection with incentives to keep landlords in the market.
tenant.zh: 关键似乎在于平衡租客保护与激励房东留在市场上的动力。

tenant.en: And by law, settlers were forbidden from renting land to native Irish tenants.
tenant.zh: 法律规定，禁止定居者将土地租给爱尔兰本地租户。

tenant.en: The idea is simple: cap how much landlords can increase rent each year, making housing more affordable for tenants.
tenant.zh: 这个想法很简单：限制房东每年提高租金的幅度，让租客更能负担得起住房。

tenant.en: A Catholic majority of tenants and workers lived beneath them, on land that had once been their own, or their parents', or their grandparents'.
tenant.zh: 占人口多数的天主教租户和工人生活在他们之下，生活在曾经属于他们自己、或他们父母、祖父母的土地上。

tempt.en: Now, it is tempting to think of this as a story from the distant past — the kind of thing that happened in a more primitive era, before science and reason arrived to improve the world.
tempt.zh: 现在，我们很容易把这当作一个遥远过去的故事——那种发生在科学和理性到来、改善世界之前那个更原始时代的事件。

tempt.en: And I have to admit that I am infinitely more impressed with those people who haven’t, the people who have forced themselves to produce English, even when there is the tempting option of getting an AI tool to write it for you.
tempt.zh: 我必须承认，我对那些没有使用人工智能的人、那些强迫自己产出英语的人（即使有让人工智能替你写的诱人选项）抱有无限的敬意。

textbook.en: I memorized word lists, studied grammar rules from a textbook, and practiced writing example sentences.
textbook.zh: 我背诵单词表，从教科书中死记硬背语法规则，并练习写例句。

textbook.en: I knew I had study time. I knew I was going to use textbooks.
textbook.zh: 我知道自己有学习时间。我知道自己会用到课本。

textbook.en: But I have lost that structure now. I don’t use the textbook correctly.
textbook.zh: 但现在我失去了这种规律。我没有正确使用课本。

textbook.en: I realized my days of vocabulary study using my textbook wasn’t working very well for me.
textbook.zh: 我意识到我过去用课本背单词的日子并没有给我带来很好的效果。

textbook.en: The invention of the printing press made it so much easier to produce exam papers and textbooks.
textbook.zh: 印刷术的发明使得印刷试卷和教科书变得容易得多。

temperament.en: This experiment proved that when you select an animal for temperament —for being "nice"—nature seems to throw in these physical changes for free.
temperament.zh: 这个实验证明，当你根据性格来挑选动物——也就是挑选“讨人喜欢”的特质时——大自然似乎会免费赠送这些身体上的改变。

temperament.en: It's a common regret. There's a little thought exercise I like to do, which is you can go back into your own life and try to put yourself in the exact position you were in five years ago 10 years ago 15 years ago 20 years ago and you try to remember okay who was i with what was i doing what was i feeling what were my emotions what were my objectives and really really try to transport yourself back and see if there's any advice you'd give yourself anything you'd do differently now you don't have new information don't pretend you could have gone back and you know bought a stock or bought Bitcoin or whatever, but just knowing what you know now in terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-related experience, how would you have done things differently?
temperament.zh: 这是一个常见的遗憾。我喜欢做一个小小的思想实验，那就是你可以回到自己的生活中，试着让自己回到五年前、十年前、十五年前、二十年前你所在的精确位置，然后试着去回忆：好吧，我和谁在一起？我在做什么？我当时有什么感觉？我的情绪是什么？我的目标是什么？真正、真正地努力把自己传送回去，看看有没有什么建议是你想给当年的自己的，有没有什么事情是你现在会做得不同的。你没有新的信息，别假装你可以回去买股票、买比特币之类；仅仅凭你现在的了解——就你的性格和一点随着年龄增长带来的经验而言，你当时会怎么做？

temperament.en: Jeffrey Miller had a tweet a long time ago that I always think about, and he said, every parenting book in the world could be replaced with one book on behavioral genetics. that i'm a big believer in genetics yes i do think a lot of behavior is downstream of genetics and i think we underplay that we like to overplay nurture and underplay nurture for us or say we'll underplay nature for societal reasons but nature is a big deal um the temperament of the person you marry is probably going to be reflected in your child by default people can change securely attached kid pick a securely attached partner well the secret to a happy relationship is two happy people right so i would say if you want to be happy then uh be with a happy person don't think you're going to be with someone who's unhappy and then make them happy down the road or if you're okay with them being unhappy but there are other things you like about them that's fine but this goes back to their unhappiness with other things yes and actually we talked a little bit about how people do connect successfully you know on spirit and and those things but that's maybe a little too abstract if you want to get a little more practical it could be based on values and values are a set of things you won't compromise on values are the tough decisions of oh my parent got sick, do they move in with us or do we put them in a nursing home?
temperament.zh: Jeffrey Miller很久以前发过一条推文，我一直记在心里，他说，世界上所有的育儿书都可以被一本行为遗传学书所取代。我非常相信遗传学，是的，我确实认为很多行为都是遗传的下游产物，我认为我们低估了这一点，我们喜欢过度强调后天培养，而为了社会原因低估了先天因素，但先天因素影响巨大，你结婚对象的脾气很可能会反映在你的孩子身上，默认情况下，人们是可以改变的，比如找一个依恋类型安全的孩子，选一个依恋类型安全的伴侣，嗯，幸福关系的秘诀是两个幸福的人，对吧？所以我认为如果你想幸福，那就和一个幸福的人在一起，不要指望和一个不幸福的人在一起，然后以后再让他们变得幸福，或者如果你能接受他们不幸福，但你喜欢他们身上的其他特质，那也可以，但这又回到了他们对其他事情的不满上，是的，其实我们之前聊过人们是如何成功建立联系的，比如在精神层面等等，但这可能太抽象了，如果想更实际一点，可以基于价值观，价值观是一套你绝不妥协的东西，价值观是那些艰难的抉择，比如：我父母生病了，他们是搬来和我们住，还是送去养老院？

terrorist.en: For example, it was named by the Norwegian terrorist Anders Breivik, who murdered 77 people in 2011.
terrorist.zh: 例如，在2011年谋杀77人的挪威恐怖分子Anders Breivik就提到了它。

terrorist.en: Firstly, newspapers don’t tend to publish terrorist manifestos.
terrorist.zh: 首先，报纸通常不会发表恐怖分子的宣言。

terrorist.en: Sure, the United States does not cooperate with terrorists.
terrorist.zh: 当然，美国是不会与恐怖分子合作的。

terrorist.en: Putin’s response was swift and brutal. He promised to hunt down the perpetrators, famously declaring, “We will pursue terrorists everywhere.
terrorist.zh: 普京的反应迅速而残酷。他承诺将追捕肇事者，并说出了那句名言：“我们将到处追捕恐怖分子。

terrorist.en: It made you the person you are today, you know? or somebody who suffered a horrible trauma or like a car accident, a terrorist attack, whatever it is, hey, it happened to you for a reason.
terrorist.zh: ‘它造就了今天的你’，你知道吗？或者某人遭受了可怕的创伤，比如车祸、恐怖袭击，无论是什么，嘿，‘这件事发生在你身上是有原因的’。

tease.en: If you’re joking around with a friend and want to tease them, just say “six seven”.
tease.zh: 如果你在和朋友开玩笑、想调侃对方，也可以直接说“six seven”。

tease.en: The man who is said to have landed the first blow, Cassius Chaerea, was a brave and distinguished Praetorian, but he was often teased by Caligula for having a high-pitched voice, and being effeminate in his manners.
tease.zh: 据说刺出第一刀的人 Cassius Chaerea 是一位勇敢杰出的禁卫军，但他经常被 Caligula 取笑声音尖锐、举止娘娘腔。

temple.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
temple.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

temple.en: Transporting stone and building large temples in such a difficult environment is a challenge.
temple.zh: 在如此困难的环境中运输石头并建造大型寺庙是一个巨大的挑战。

temple.en: It’s best known for its enormous pyramid called El Castillo or the Temple of Kukulcan.
temple.zh: 它最著名的标志是被称为“埃尔卡斯蒂略”或“库库尔坎神庙”的巨大金字塔。

temple.en: The Great Temple at the center of Tenochtitlán was replaced by the Metropolitan Cathedral.
temple.zh: 位于特诺奇蒂特兰中心的大神庙被大都会大教堂所取代。

temple.en: The Olmec constructed ceremonial centers with large platforms, plazas and temples.
temple.zh: 奥尔梅克人建造了带有大型平台、广场和神庙的礼仪中心。

terminate.en: And her response was, well, you know we have to terminate you.
terminate.zh: 而她的回复是，嗯，你知道我们不得不解雇你。

terminate.en: It was only - what? - 12 bucks. And she said, no, in cases like that, you automatically have to terminate the employee.
terminate.zh: 才——多少？——12块钱。她说，不，遇到这种情况，你必须自动被解雇。

terminate.en: DOGE’s website proudly displayed a “Wall of Receipts,” listing thousands of terminated contracts and grants, with savings they claimed reached $205 billion by August 2025, a savings of $1,273.29 per taxpayer.
terminate.zh: DOGE 的网站自豪地展示了一面“收据墙”，上面列出了数千份被终止的合同和赠款，并声称截至 2025 年 8 月节省的资金达到了 2050 亿美元，相当于为每个纳税人节省了 1,273.29 美元。

terrain.en: The Iberians, from what is now Spain, were fierce and mobile, and were especially suited to mountainous terrain.
terrain.zh: 来自今西班牙的伊比利亚人凶猛且机动性强，特别适合山地作战。

terrain.en: The terrain was treacherous, and the weather brutal.
terrain.zh: 这里地形险恶，天气残酷。

terrain.en: The Arab forces had the advantage of mobility, knowledge of the terrain, and motivation, but they lacked the heavy weaponry, discipline, and resources of the Ottoman army.
terrain.zh: 阿拉伯军队拥有机动性、地形知识和动力等优势，但缺乏奥斯曼军队那样的重型武器、纪律和资源。

terrain.en: Fawcett was told by the president of the Society that, and I’m quoting directly, “the terrain was all but impassable, it would take up two years and there was no guarantee of survival.”
terrain.zh: 学会会长对 Fawcett 说，我在这里直接引述原话，“那里的地形几乎无法通行，需要耗时两年，而且无法保证能活下来。”

terrain.en: The journey was brutal. Lawrence, Faisal’s fighters, and the fearsome Bedouin cavalry, led by a fierce warrior named Auda abu Tayi, crossed nearly 1000 kilometres of some of the harshest terrain on Earth, suffering from thirst, exhaustion, and the relentless heat.
terrain.zh: 旅程非常残酷。Lawrence、Prince Faisal 的战士们以及由勇猛战士 Auda abu Tayi 领导的可怕的贝都因骑兵，穿越了地球上近 1000 公里最恶劣的地形，忍受着干渴、疲惫和无情的酷热。

tendency.en: To his critics, he was Mubarak 2.0: same military playbook, same authoritarian tendencies, just a new face.
tendency.zh: 在他的批评者看来，他是 Mubarak 2.0：同样的军事套路，同样的专制倾向，只是换了一张新面孔。

tendency.en: But his tendency to experiment and take a lot of time frustrated his patrons, who expected quicker results.
tendency.zh: 但他喜欢实验和耗费大量时间的倾向，让期待更快看到结果的赞助人感到沮丧。

tendency.en: I'm glad that it exists. You don't see it much yet in large scale production systems replacing humans because this tendency to hallucinate.
tendency.zh: 我很高兴它存在。你还没有在大规模生产系统中看到它取代人类，因为这种幻觉倾向。

tendency.en: But these sort of tech titans, as we're thinking about them--there's a tendency, and it is a very flawed and mistaken tendency, a deeply flawed and mistaken tendency, to identify entrepreneurship with those few people--these few very wealthy, Silicon-Valley-situated success stories.
tendency.zh: 但当我们想到这些所谓的科技巨头时——存在一种倾向，而这是一种非常有缺陷、非常错误的倾向，一种根深蒂固的谬误——那就是把企业家精神等同于这少数几个人，等同于这几个身处硅谷、家财万贯的成功故事。

tendency.en: But these sort of tech titans, as we're thinking about them--there's a tendency, and it is a very flawed and mistaken tendency, a deeply flawed and mistaken tendency, to identify entrepreneurship with those few people--these few very wealthy, Silicon-Valley-situated success stories.
tendency.zh: 但当我们想到这些所谓的科技巨头时——存在一种倾向，而这是一种非常有缺陷、非常错误的倾向，一种根深蒂固的谬误——那就是把企业家精神等同于这少数几个人，等同于这几个身处硅谷、家财万贯的成功故事。

terminal.en: It is a curious story that takes us from Ancient Mesopotamia to the Middle East, from southern France to modern airport terminals.
terminal.zh: 这是一个引人入胜的故事，带我们从古代的美索不达米亚走到中东，从法国南部走到现代的机场航站楼。

testimony.en: There is a photograph of him strolling around London with a well-known Czech spy, and there is the testimony of a high-ranking Czech spy, who had no discernible motive to lie.
testimony.zh: 有一张他与一名著名的捷克间谍在伦敦散步的照片，还有一名捷克高级间谍的证词，而那个人并没有明显的撒谎动机。

textile.en: Bengal--the textile revolution began in Bengal and actually then migrated to the United Kingdom.
textile.zh: 孟加拉——纺织业革命最早就发端于孟加拉，后来才转移到了英国。

textile.en: This tree produced a red dye that was used in Europe for creating luxury textiles.
textile.zh: 这种树产一种红色染料，在欧洲被用来制作奢侈纺织品。

textile.en: For centuries, ships carrying valuable goods, like spices and silk, porcelain, textiles, and metal, passed through this region.
textile.zh: 几个世纪以来，载有香料、丝绸、瓷器、纺织品和金属等贵重商品的船只穿梭于该地区。

textile.en: Long story short, people from the countryside flocked to the cities to work in factories, producing everything from textiles to tools to iron.
textile.zh: 长话短说，乡村人口涌入城市进入工厂工作，生产从纺织品、工具到钢铁的一切物品。

telescope.en: Mathematicians don’t look through telescopes or use microscopes.
telescope.zh: 数学家不通过望远镜或使用显微镜观察。

terminology.en: You already know the terminology, many of the road rules and how driving tests usually work.
terminology.zh: 你已经了解专业术语、许多交通规则以及驾照考试通常是如何运作的。

terminology.en: It was both freaky and familiar to hear Will using all this ominous terminology I'd grown up with, but almost completely forgotten.
terminology.zh: 听到Will使用所有这些我从小听过但几乎已经快忘光的阴森术语，既诡异又熟悉。

terminology.en: It wasn’t easy. I went from knowing almost nothing about Japanese road signs, traffic rules, or driving terminology to passing both my provisional and main license written tests on the first try.
terminology.zh: 这并不容易。我从几乎不懂日本的道路标志、交通规则或驾驶术语，到一次性通过了临时驾照和正式驾照的笔试。

terrific.en: I was pulling up the table, but you remembered off the cuff a lot of the highlights, and I think that the jump from whale oil to electrification is a terrific example.
terrific.zh: 我刚才还在找那张表格，但你已经脱口而出记住了很多要点，我觉得从鲸油照明跃迁到电气化，就是一个绝佳的例子。

tent.en: Yeah, exactly. We'll put them in the other tent.
tent.zh: 没错，正是这样。把他们放在另一个帐篷里。

tent.en: Okay. So there's a lot of that that goes on in child rearing thanks to really bad studies and bad public medical directive so for example you know uh a few uh a few parents you maybe they're drunk or they're high or they're just other issues and you know they roll over their kid when they're sleeping the kid suffocates or they neglect their kid and then co-sleeping having them in the bed yeah exactly or they're you know the the modern proclamation and so because of that they say well don't co-sleep with your kids well the kids in every society through all of human history co-slept with their parents where else do you think they were sleeping they weren't houses in multiple We'll put them in the other tent.
tent.zh: 好的。所以在育儿方面，由于糟糕的研究和错误的公共医疗指导，这种现象很多。比如，有些父母可能喝醉了、吸毒了或者有其他问题，他们在睡觉时压到了孩子导致孩子窒息，或者他们忽视了孩子，然后就把同床睡、把孩子放在床上当成借口。没错，正是这样。或者他们会说，这是现代的声明，所以他们说，别和孩子同床睡。但人类历史上每个社会的孩子都是和父母同床睡的。你以为他们还能睡在哪？他们又没有多房间的房子，把孩子放在另一个帐篷里。
